🌟 geo-seo-claude | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To optimize websites for the evolving landscape of AI-powered search engines and improve their visibility and performance in AI-driven search results.
✨ Key Features: • GEO-first SEO optimization for AI search engines • Citability scoring for AI citation readiness
📖 Summary: This Python repository provides a "GEO-first" SEO skill for Claude Code, designed to optimize websites for AI-powered search engines like ChatGPT and Gemini while maintaining traditional SEO practices. It offers a suite of tools for comprehensive website analysis, including citability scoring, AI crawler access checks, brand authority assessment, and schema markup generation.
